title: Optimize Training Convergence
description:
1. Fix `self.scan` initialization to 10.0 to match data distribution.
2. Tune reward function: Reduce `collision_penalty` to -50.0 to prevent 'freezing' behavior.

title: Upgrade Policy Model to LSTM
description: Enable LSTM in the PPO policy configuration to handle temporal dependencies and potential partial observability. Update `src/rl_training/config/forklift_ppo.yaml` to set `class_name: ActorCriticRecurrent` (if applicable) or add `rnn_type: 'lstm'` parameters depending on rsl_rl version support.
